input.creator_request: Narrated story. My voiceover is uploaded, so match the video length to it. Title: "One light on the coast". Use every uploaded file, in this order, and show each shot while I say its line: the lighthouse from the rocks below, then a close up of the lamp · Every ship that reached this bay for a century looked for one light. an old portrait of the first keeper · The first keeper arrived with a lamp, a logbook and a cat. the two old sepia photos of the cottage, the second one with the keeper at the door · She kept watch for forty winters. She reportedly said: "The sea keeps its own hours." the old sepia photo of the dark tower · Then the keepers left and the tower went dark. the old sepia photo of the rusted stairs · Storms cracked the lens room and the stairs rusted through. volunteers painting the tower · Neighbours repaired it one weekend at a time, paid for with bake sales. the lamp room with the new lens · This spring the beam turned again for the first time in decades. the whole headland at dusk · Would you climb those stairs every night? Caption the voiceover one sentence at a time and keep the captions out of the lowest fifth of the frame. Show no other text besides the title. Calm pace with soft crossfades. Give the five photos a slow zoom. Keep the sepia shots sepia; colour returns with the modern shots
input.goal: Opening on the lighthouse as the voiceover starts; moving into the sepia photos of the first keeper; showing the restoration as the story reaches today; ending on the headland at dusk for the closing question
